# GAP-113: `GENERATED BY DEFAULT ON NULL AS IDENTITY` loses `ON NULL`

Oracle feature: an identity column that also fills itself in when an
`INSERT` passes `NULL` for it explicitly, not only when the column is
left out.

## Minimal example

```sql
CREATE TABLE t_on_null (
  id   NUMBER GENERATED BY DEFAULT ON NULL AS IDENTITY,
  name VARCHAR2(10)
);
INSERT INTO t_on_null (id, name) VALUES (NULL, 'explicit');
INSERT INTO t_on_null (name) VALUES ('omitted');
```

In a live Oracle 23ai both inserts succeed, with `id` 1 and 2.

## ora2pg output (v25.0, `-t TABLE`)

From the hand-written spelling:

```sql
CREATE TABLE t_on_null (
	id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
	name varchar(10)
) ;
```

and from `DBMS_METADATA.GET_DDL`'s spelling (`… GENERATED BY DEFAULT ON
NULL AS IDENTITY MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE … NOT NULL ENABLE`):

```sql
CREATE TABLE hr.t_on_null (
	id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 INCREMENT BY 1 START WITH 1 CACHE 20 NO CYCLE),
	name varchar(10)
) ;
```

`ON NULL` is gone from both. PostgreSQL has no such option.

## Observed problem

The DDL loads. The first insert then fails in PostgreSQL 16:

```
ERROR:  null value in column "id" of relation "t_on_null" violates not-null constraint
DETAIL:  Failing row contains (null, explicit).
```

The second one works. So code that leaves the column out keeps working,
and code that passes `NULL` on purpose — a generic insert routine, an ORM
that lists every column — fails on its first call.

This is not GAP-031. That gap is the column default `DEFAULT ON NULL
<expr>`, which ora2pg copies verbatim and PostgreSQL rejects at load
time; the identity spelling ora2pg does convert. `default_on_null`
flagged the identity spelling as GAP-031 until this gap was split out.

**Reproducible: YES.** Ora2Pg version: 25.0, PostgreSQL 16, Oracle 23ai.

## Verdict

**Gap confirmed, severity high, failure_stage runtime.** Fixed with a
`BEFORE INSERT` trigger that sets the column from its sequence when
`NEW.id IS NULL`, or by changing the code to leave the column out.

Implemented: `ora2pg_gap_report/detectors/identity_on_null.py` — searches
a table's column list, `GLOBAL TEMPORARY` tables included.
